name: Everstone Daycare
source:
Take on the role of the hapless human transformed and whisked away against their will to the colorful Everstone Daycare! Find a way to leave the daycare before the way back to your world is closed to you forever. Behave during your time inside and enjoy the relaxation and pleasures offered by the Daycare, or be sent to the Retraining area and face the unusual and humiliating punishments that the Nurse staff has in store for troublemakers (like you!).

Everstone Daycare is a 18+ primarily M/M-focused game (but also includes several M/F scenes) that features heavy kink, particularly ABDL, themes. It is set in the perspective of a male protagonist as he is punished, teased, and embarassed by several other characters big and small.

[From [url=https://12games.itch.io/everstone-daycare-public-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演不幸的人类角色，被改造并违背自己的意愿被带到色彩缤纷的Everstone日托中心！在返回世界的路永远对你关闭之前，想办法离开日托中心。在里面的时候要表现得好，享受日托所提供的放松和乐趣，或者被送到再培训区，面对护士工作人员为麻烦制造者（像你这样！）准备的不寻常和羞辱性的惩罚。

Everstone Daycare是一款18岁以上主要针对M/M的游戏（但也包括几个M/F场景），具有严重的扭结主题，特别是ABDL主题。故事以男主角的视角展开，他受到其他大大小小的角色的惩罚、戏弄和羞辱。

[来自[url=https://12games.itch.io/everstone-daycare-public-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
